review_notes: I reviewed the whole file: `Opens.grothendieckTopology`, `Opens.pretopology`, the two comparison theorems, and `coversTop_iff`. I searched Mathlib for other Grothendieck topologies or pretopologies on `Opens T`. The only definitions are the two in this file, and many Sheaves files use `Opens.grothendieckTopology`. The topology and the pretopology are deliberately separate definitions, as the implementation notes say. The file also proves they induce each other, so they don't compete. I found no competing definition in Mathlib, Batteries or core. I did not check the Lean core and Batteries trees, since generic Grothendieck-site concepts are not defined there.
